params.basis: solo burst-gen test (not a scope-lock accuracy reconciliation — purpose-built to observe her own burst-gauge generation in isolation, no teammates diluting the shared bar)
params.focusReason: solo recording — she is the only unit, so the team gauge bar is entirely her own contribution

method: ffmpeg crop+tile contact sheets at 5fps over the ammo/popup region (crop=700:250:250:100 within the documented damage-area crop) and the burst-gauge region (crop=260:100:2380:430), read by eye; shot timestamps cross-checked against the ammo-counter decrement; fill percentages estimated from the light(filled)/dark(empty) boundary position in a contrast-boosted crop of the gauge bar

popups.note: first clean read of the recurring value; grows in steps of ~82012 tracking shot count — read as summed concurrent DoT ticks, not a single fixed-value hit
recurs unchanged across the clip — read as her actual RL weapon shot (core hit), distinct from the growing white DoT-sum value

notes: PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THIS RECORDING was not the popups above but the burst-gauge FILL TIMELINE, which settled open-questions U37 (see docs/answered-questions.md). Shot timestamps (from ammo-counter decrements, 6-round RL magazine) vs measured gauge-bar fill %: shot1 ~8.8s/~0%, shot2 ~11.0s/~15%, shot3 ~12.8s/~38%, shot4 ~14.8s/~67%, shot5 ~16.8s/~80%, shot6(empties mag) ~18.2s/~89%, post-reload ~20.8s/~98%, shot7 ~22.6s/100% (chain opens, green stage-1 hexagon visible). Per-shot fill increment ramps (+15,+23,+29) then plateaus (+13,+9,+9) — the signature of concurrent DoT-tick stacking (her measured ~2.7-2.9 average instance concurrency) rather than a flat single-instance rate. n=1 recording; fill percentages are eyeballed off a contrast-boosted crop, not pixel-measured — treat the qualitative ramp-then-plateau shape as the load-bearing finding, not the exact percentages. Boss identity not determined from footage (generic mech enemy, not visually identified by element); marked null/neutral pending confirmation, though boss element is irrelevant to this gauge-timing question.
